author: hasl
body:
Hey Senior staff team,

I recently learned that there were supposed to be a couple of seniors that have a background duty of focussing on the community.
John (Demur) and Seth (Edans) correct?

I acknowledge that John has posted two 'Staff Spotlights' and Seth has organised two 'Map Testings', but surely they should be striving to accomplish more than just that.
Perhaps feedback on recent ideas the staff team has conjured up or suggestions on how to approach a recent incident in the future.

Appreciation in advance.

- Aura

title: Community seniors?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Aura,

Yes that is correct, both John and Seth are in a department that focuses around the community. We have currently been planning community events which we could do in the near future and a few various other things. Recently the Senior team has been a bit inactive, a lot of the Senior Staff members have had or are still having exams, so activity is up and down. This is why it may appear as though not much is being done. 

I'll leave this open for any further questions regarding my response, if not then tell me and i'll lock and tag this.
